mapper.select:
select bs.* from shebao_benefit_suspension bs left join shebao_subsidy_person sp on sp.id = bs.subsidy_person_id where bs.del_flag = '0' and (sp.del_flag = '0' or sp.id is null) and exists ( select 1 from shebao_benefit_suspension_item bsi where bsi.suspension_id = bs.id and bsi.del_flag = '0' and bsi.pause_active = '1' )
and bs.pause_reason = #{req.pauseReason}
and sp.name like concat('%', #{req.name}, '%')
and bs.id_card_no like concat('%', #{req.idCardNo}, '%')
order by bs.create_time desc, bs.id desc
